_what: How another party's words are made safe to quote inside a turn an AI reads (src/untrusted-text.mjs quoteUntrusted). Every step is DATA: a step can be switched off or retuned by editing this file, with no code change. Order: normalise, strip, escape, truncate.

strip._what: Unicode general categories removed outright (control characters, and format characters such as bidi overrides, zero-width joiners and the byte order mark), except the characters listed in keep.

escape._what: Each character on the left is replaced by the text on the right so quoted words can never close or open a tag around themselves. The full-width and angle-bracket lookalikes are written as code points so the file stays readable.
